programme.title: Buffalo Keepers
programme.desc: Today, the buffalo is the quintessential symbol of strength, freedom, and the unspoiled American West. But in the late 1800s, the nation's buffalo were nearly wiped out by ruthless hide hunters. Those majestic herds, which once numbered in the tens of millions, were down to less than 500 animals. This is the story of the handful of determined men and women who mobilized to save the ones that were left in a last-ditch effort to stave off extinction. Ranchers like Charles and Mary Ann Goodnight rescued orphaned buffalo calves and built small herds. Former buffalo hunters like Buffalo Bill helped build public sympathy. And politicians like Theodore Roosevelt helped pass laws to protect the remaining animals. The effort would be a generational one, with buffalo herds carefully tended, bred, and passed down to new stewards when their old protectors passed away. Thanks to their efforts, there are an estimated 500,000 buffalo thundering across America's grasslands once again.

programme.title: Dark Blue

Known for his tough street tactics and a fiery temper, Eldon also tutors rookie Bobby Keough (Scott Speedman) in the grim realities of police intimidation and corruption. While navigating the tumultuous neighborhoods of South Central L.A., Perry and Keough must track down the cold-blooded killers as well as face their own demons - demons that prove more ruthless than the criminals they pursue.

programme.title: Man Of The West

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Eight months ago, 23-year-old Robert Gibbs weighed close to 800 pounds, and fearing he would lose his life to obesity, made a desperate plea for Dr. Phil’s help in a YouTube video. It took two medical vans and five EMTs to get him to the show, and he had to be wheeled onstage. Dr. Phil arranged for Robert to go to straight from the show to Wellspring Academy. Find out how he is doing today! Then, when Susanne first appeared on Dr. Phil she weighed 541 pounds and boasted that she consumed up to 30,000 calories a day in hopes of becoming the world’s biggest bride by weighing 800 pounds by her June 2013 wedding. Dr. Phil warned the 33-year-old that she was on a dangerous path and offered her the opportunity to seek treatment at Wellspring at Structure House weight loss facility. It’s been five months -- how is she doing? See what happens when Dr. Phil pays her a surprise visit. And, hear from Susanne's family members. You won’t believe who she says is trying to sabotage her! Then, Dr. Phil surprises his nephew Scott, who has been at the same Wellspring at Structure House weight loss center for seven months and has lost more than 130 pounds. What does he say is the biggest key to his weight loss? And, how does he stay motivated?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A former FLDS spokesperson, Willie Jessop, comes face to face with critics.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven college students recount their harrowing experience of being deceived by an online predator.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples confront post-honeymoon marriage challenges.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they saw several red flags before they walked down the aisle, but they looked the other way and still said, "I do."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: 16 and on the Path of Destruction
programme.desc: A mother describes her daughter's self-destructive behaviors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when a perfect wedding turns into a perfect disaster? Marlee got so drunk at her own wedding that she had to be put to bed before she could even cut the cake! Two years later, she and her husband are still fighting about it. Plus, Patrick can't even remember marrying his bride! See what caused his amnesia and ruined their big day. And, a woman who thinks her catastrophic wedding means her marriage was doomed from the start. Dr. Phil has advice for moving past wedding disasters.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nina says even after she lowered her 15-year-old daughter, Nicolette’s, monthly allowance from $5,000 to $1,000, Nicolette is still overspending on her credit cards in order to keep up with teens in their hometown of Beverly Hills. Nina says she recently allowed a family friend, Joel, to move into her home so he could help chauffeur Nicolette around and watch her spending. Nicolette admits to spending her day having lunch in Beverly Hills, shopping, and making YouTube videos. Nina and Joel say they worry about Nicolette, who admits to having zero future goals except to not work, be rich, wear designer clothes and drive a Mercedes G-Wagen. Dr. Phil surprises Nicolette, her mother, and Joel by sending Nicolette on a special assignment near Skid Row in downtown Los Angeles a few days prior to taping Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Feuds between neighbors are examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Son is a 40YO Homeless Camper
programme.desc: 41 year old man lives in his car but claims he isn't homeless.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Today's guests are sick and tired of a relative's never-ending mooching ways! Will these extreme freeloaders learn to stand on their own two feet?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: I Want To See My Kids!
programme.desc: Brad says he is deadlocked in a bitter custody battle with his ex, Kimberly, who he claims has kept him from seeing their three kids for the past seven months. Kimberly says Brad is unstable and irresponsible, and until he cleans up his act, she can’t allow him to see their kids. Can these exes learn to peacefully co-parent?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Wrath of My Mother Wanda (PT 1)
programme.desc: Things get a little wild with a very passionate guest named Wanda. Her daughter, Tiffany, told her mother she ruined her wedding, among many other things. But Wanda says Tiffany is making up lies about her and she knows why; Wanda claims it’s payback for Wanda having an affair and abandoning the family when Tiffany was just 14 years old. Wanda says her bipolar disorder is at fault for her earlier actions. Tiffany says she is sick of her mother blaming her mental health issues for her bad behavior. Tiffany says if Dr. Phil can’t fix this, then her mother is out of her life for good. Can Dr. Phil get this mother-daughter duo to see eye to eye for the first time?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when your perfect wedding day turns into a perfect nightmare? One bride fainted on her walk down the aisle and cries every time she thinks about it. Now, Dr. Phil gives her a second chance to say, “I do.” Another guest was so stressed out about fitting into a tiny gown that she became anorexic. But is her eating disorder just a symptom of a deeper issue? Plus, “Wedding Etiquette” author Peggy Post helps one shy bride overcome her fear of being in the spotlight on her wedding day.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever wonder how your favorite Dr. Phil guest is faring since being on the show? Dr. Phil follows up with some of his most talked about guests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Lazy Husbands and Cling On Kids
programme.desc: When you think of negotiations, you may think of corporate boardrooms, but negotiating happens every day " even in your own house. Learn the principles of making a deal, how to compromise to get what you want and the biggest mistakes you can make when buying a new car. Plus, learn the five things you might not realize you can bargain for!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The hot topic of what defines a "good wife" is debated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother says her teen daughter is aggressive, violent and a bully who crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three families with one thing in common: they say their daughters, collegiate student-athletes, were suffering in silence before they died by suicide. They say their daughters faced immense pressure to balance it all, something that many student-athletes face, but often don’t express due to the stigma around mental health. All three families are pushing for change and more conversations about mental health on campus. Then, Thomas, a current student-athlete, shares his story of struggling with mental health as a D1 football player. He attempted to take his life but now shares his story as a message to others who may also be suffering alone.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents, listen up! Did you know that 94 percent of American kids ages 12 to 17 use the Internet, and 58 percent of them have an online profile? We're living in a digital world, where photos and other content can be published online for the world to see in an instant. You may not know it, but your child may be one click away from disaster.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the Dr. Phil House's Man Camp Edition, one husband is defiant, while others are reflective and one couple faces expulsion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Out Of The Cult Follow Up
programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with a family whose story captivated viewers. Fourteen siblings say they suffered horrific beatings and molestation at the hands of their own father, who claimed to be the Messiah. The oldest daughter, Jeanne, says she was not only abused by her dad, but was forced to brutally beat her younger brothers and sisters to please their controlling patriarch. After the show, the relatives say they made great strides toward reconciliation, but tension and resentment still exist. Miriam and Sarah say Jeanne doesn’t physically abuse them anymore, but they still feel hurt by her constant judgments. They say she always preaches to them and criticizes them for drinking alcohol and for taking jobs as exotic dancers. Another sibling, Jewel, who recently reconnected with the family after 13 years, says Jeanne is jealous of her new bond with the family. Can the women heal the wounds of the past and move on with their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obesity is a huge problem for adults in this country, but now it’s becoming an epidemic among children as young as 3 years old. Barbra says her 3-year-old daughter started gaining weight at six months old and now weighs 80 pounds. Barbra and her aunt, Dana, are baffled by what they believe is a medical mystery because they say the little girl doesn't overeat. Dr. Phil brings in two medical experts to get to the bottom of this issue. Is Barbra contributing to her child's weight gain? Then, Tammy says she can’t change her family's eating habits. She's obese, her 11-year-old is 175 pounds and her 9-year-old is 136 pounds. Her sister, Debbie, says the boys portion sizes are too big and the family is just lazy. Can Dr. Phil get Tammy to stick to a nutrition plan? You won’t believe the surprise he has for her! Plus, Jessica says her mom, Angie, is blind to the health issues of her 351-pound sister, Jaleisa, who is only 15. Angie says her mom never buys healthy food, and fears she has Munchausen’s syndrome. Angie says she can’t monitor Jaleisa’s eating habits all day. Can Angie turn this situation around and save her daughter’s life, or is it too late?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Twenty-three-year-old Robert, who tips the scales at nearly 800 pounds, earned national attention when he made a desperate plea for Dr. Phil’s help in a YouTube video that tallied more than a million views. With his call answered, see Robert make the arduous journey to Dr. Phil’s stage with the assistance of two medical vans and five EMTs. Dr. Phil and Robert take a closer look at how he put on the weight, and what he needs to do to take it off. Is he really ready to make a change? Will Robert grab onto the lifeline Dr. Phil throws his way? And, Robert’s mother, Nanette, shares her insight into her son’s weight struggles. Has she unintentionally been enabling her son's condition? What role will she play in his recovery? Then, you may remember self-admitted adult baby, Brett who stirred controversy after he and his then-girlfriend, Cat, first appeared on Dr. Phil. Are they still a couple? Then, Meet Bill, who says he’d like to adopt Brett and be his new “daddy.” Will Brett accept his offer?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Diana says her 48-year-old husband, Robert, weighs nearly 400 pounds and is in denial about his weight -- and she’s considering divorcing him if he doesn’t get serious about making a change. Diana, who weighs 104 pounds, admits that she often nags and ridicules Robert about his weight and says she’s afraid he’ll die at any moment -- or require round-the-clock care, like his mother did before her obesity-related death in 2003. Why does Robert say he’s overweight? Is he finally ready to shed the extra pounds? Plus, Diana admits that she has struggled with an eating problem for several years. Can she, too, learn to develop a healthier relationship with food? Then, 33-year-old Rose says she weighs nearly 300 pounds and is tired of being overweight. She says her husband, Jonathan, is in great shape, and she wants to be his “trophy wife,” but she needs help curbing her cravings for her favorite foods -- including maple syrup sandwiches. Dr. Phil calls on Dr. Travis Stork, host of the Emmy Award-winning talk show The Doctors and author of the new book, The Doctor’s Diet, to help these guests adopt healthier eating habits and get them on the road to weight loss. Learn about his three-phase plan for reaching -- and maintaining -- your ideal weight. Could it work for you?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with women who say they feel forgotten by their loved ones because of their excessive weight. Lorna weighs 650-plus pounds and feels abandoned by her family. Lorna’s sister, Glenice, says Lorna got herself into this situation; now she has to take responsibility and get herself out. Lorna’s boyfriend, Blair, takes care of her, but Glenice says he’s not the Mr. Nice Guy he appears to be. She says he's really an abuser. Lorna says Blair is exhausted and stressed from the hard job of caring for her, and her family needs to help rather than drive him away. Is Lorna ready to stop accepting the abuse and start accepting help? Then, Sunni weighs almost 300 pounds and wants to pursue her dream of being a plus-size model. Her boyfriend, Christian, however, says she’s too fat for the runway, and she should leave that dream to the skinny girls. Sunni says she is big and fabulous, and Christian makes her feel like she should crawl under a rock. Will Sunni be forced to pick between her relationship and her dream? Dr. Phil has some surprises for Sunni.

programme.desc: Pastor Ronald Williams and his late wife, Patti, founded Hephzibah House in 1971, a Christian boarding school for teen girls. programme.title: Civil Love
programme.desc: Rachel is a widow during the Civil War who holds the South responsible for her husband's death. When a wounded enemy soldier takes refuge in her barn, Rachel reluctantly helps him. programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance

When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn’t meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen’s "Emma."

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: During the '70s, our top scientists and astronomers sent coded messages into space with the hopes of getting a response from an extraterrestrial civilization. We discuss who sent the message, its encoded response and the encounters humanity would experience in the near future.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: While shooting pool in a Louisiana bar, Andre Daigle meets a beautiful and mysterious woman. That night he disappears. With no clues to go on, Andre's family calls in psychic Rosemarie Kerr - whose remarkable visions provide answers to a baffling crime. In New Jersey, a teenage girl vanishes while walking home from school. Witnesses saw her walking near a young man whose alibi is shaky. But police have no evidence and must release the suspect - who then vanishes himself. Psychic Nancy Orlen Weber joins the case and offers uncannily accurate descriptions of the crime, the suspect - and where he's hiding.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Hard Knocks
programme.desc: Hard Knocks is your go-to destination for MMA and Fighter action!

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four teams comprised of celebrities and veteran roboteers. Which celebrity has a natural flare for mechanical combat and who will be having words with their agent when they end up in the pit?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first ever Robot Wars heat begins. Six brave teams enter the arena for the first time as the four House Robots are unleashed to do what they were made for, turning competitors into twisted and scorched lumps.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Heat B features six contestants, all battling for a spot in the series finals. To make it through, they must prove their mettle in the Gauntlet, Trial (British Bulldog) and battle it out in the Arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six more contestants enter the arena. This week the arena transforms into a Robot football pitch and Sergeant Bash meets his match. Which contestant will score a place in the finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Lightweight special; the six contestants this week make up for what they lack in size, with agility. Can they weave their way through the house robots in the gauntlet? Or will they knock each other off-course in this week’s trial, stock car racing?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six contestants enter the arena, but how many will leave? As the robots navigate their way through this week’s trial, the Labyrinth, who knows what lies around each corner? Victory or elimination?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: No cues necessary as six new contestants play robot snooker in this week’s trial. The victors of this heat will be joining the other winners in the Grand Final. Who will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The First Wars?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: When the competitor’s weapons aren’t quite doing the job, they must resort to using the arena to secure the win. There’s not enough room for the both of them, which robot from the Isle of Sheppey will prove itself the best in this chance encounter.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: World Champions meet a newcomer in this episode’s heat, will it be an easy appetiser, or a major upset? One uneventful round leaves the house robots responsible for entertaining the crowd.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last heats of the fifth series. Matilda breaks the rules and strays from her zone, inflicting massive damage on unsuspecting robots, much to the dismay of the judges.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The semi-finals are here and the competitors step up a notch, even the house robots need to be cautious. One of the three losers of the first rounds have an opportunity for redemption in the Losers Melee.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After this episode, the Grand Final lineup will be decided. With pressure mounting the robots are going all out. One competitor is sent to the clouds with the help of another. The house robots help decide who makes it to through.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This episode, Robot Wars: The Fifth Wars will have a champion. As the proven best robots of the series gather one last time, the competition has never been more evenly matched.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Dynamic duo Craig Charles and Philippa Forrester are back for the Sixth Wars. Two-time World champions and Fifth Wars Champions compete in this explosive first episode, will their hopes be dashed at the start?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The competitors waste no time getting stuck into the fray in the four way melees, with one robot seemingly dominating the competition. The house robots may be a little rusty as a robot launches an attack.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Former two-time UK champion returns to the arena, and after losing its title in the last series, they have a score to settle. Will another robot foil their plans and take their spot in the finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The four way melee shows how closely matched the robots are in a nail-biting first round. Mr Psycho gets an opportunity to use his colossal hammer against a competitor. The arena suffers more damage from one of the robots devastating weapon.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight more competitors take on the four way melees to try and secure a spot in the final. A robot seemingly eliminates itself from the competition. The judges make difficult decisions in yet another well-matched heat.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer braves the arena against seven veterans in this heat. Mr. Psycho continues to smash any robot unfortunate to get close, cementing his position as a feared house robot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An even number of newcomers and veterans prepare themselves to do battle. House robots once again team up against the vulnerable robots, only to be saved by the ever generous Refbot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The judges make a controversial decision during the four way melee. Some robots are too strong for their own good as their weapons damage their opponents and also themselves. An intense heat final will decide a worthy winner.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Despite being teamed up on, a competitor manages to outsmart their opponents. Sergeant Bash gets a taste of his own medicine. The house robots play a vital role in deciding the winner of the heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Three axe robots meet in round one as they attempt to chop each other out of the competition. In the semi-finals Growler gets their first real taste of metal.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A competitor feels the heat of the house robots in the first round. One competitor’s weapon easily immobilizes their opponent, leaving it for the house robots to play with. Two similar robots meet in the final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight more competitors brave the Robot Wars arena. One of the robot’s attacks backfires in the semi-finals, leading to a tight final with an unexpected conclusion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer makes it to the semi-finals, will they hold their own against the veterans? Two-time World Champions and Fifth Wars Champions Razer battle first as they attempt to gain yet another title.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An all veteran, action-packed semi-final. The house robots do not hesitate to get involved as the competitors do anything it takes to eliminate their opponents. The Loser’s Melee gives knocked out competitors a chance for redemption.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: 96 Robots, down to four. The Grand Final is here and the competition is fierce, only the best robot will survive and win the title of Robot Wars: The Sixth Wars champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Robot Wars returns. The House Robots have been upgraded and are ready to dismantle any of the 40 competing teams brave enough to enter the hazardous arena.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Ray Scott had no plan other than a hypothetical idea of launching a legitimate pro bass fishing tour. Through his uncanny salesmanship the 1967 All-American was a success leading to the formation of the Bass Anglers Sportsman Society (B.A.S.S.).

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: By the 1980s B.A.S.S. was gaining national media notoriety while membership swelled to nearly 500 000. The Bassmasters TV series debuted in 1984 to capture the drama as it unfolded on the water. The show followed the Bassmaster Tournament Trail.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: B.A.S.S. in the 90s was best described as explosive and exciting. A legend won his fourth Bassmaster Classic while another hero retired. Another became the first B.A.S.S. millionaire.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bill Dance a furniture salesman from Memphis Tenn. caught the first bass in Scott’s 1967 All-American tournament a harbinger of great things to come. Dance went on to become the sport’s first superstar fueled by his outgoing charisma.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Roland Martin early on established himself as a B.A.S.S. superstar by winning 19 tournaments. Jimmy Houston’s recognizable giggle mop of blonde hair and wide-framed sunglasses made him an instant hit.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Hank Parker who won the Classic in 1979 and 1989 also won 1983 B.A.S.S. Angler of the Year. In 14 years as a B.A.S.S. pro Parker qualified for 14 Classics before retiring at the age of 37 going on to be successful with his Hank Parker Outdoor Magazine.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Voted by fans as the greatest professional bass angler of all time Rick Clunn won four Bassmaster Classics two of them in consecutive years and went on to compete in an unprecedented 32 Classics.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the story of a river and how it inspired three innovators and dedicated bass fishermen to invent and build an industry and culture that meant everything to them. Those men are Johnny Morris Forrest Wood and Jerry McKinnis.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of Rick Clunn’s 50-year B.A.S.S. career leading up to his 500th event.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of superstar Denny Brauer’s incredible career spanning three decades with a Bassmaster Classic win Bassmaster Angler of the Year title 17 wins and in incredible impact on the sport of bass fishing.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bryan Kerchal is the only amateur angler to win the Bassmaster Classic. See the heartwarming story of his career on The Cast presented by Bass Pro Shops.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.sub-title: The Greatest Show in Bass Fishing - The Bassmaster Classic
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of bass fishing’s greatest show. From the fans and the fanfare to the anglers and 54 years of history it’s all about the Bassmaster Classic.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Dive into the fascinating history of fishing and discover how ingenuity and innovation have transformed this ancient practice.

programme.desc: Explore the history of fishing tackle featuring expert interviews and hands on demonstrations. A must watch for anglers and history buffs alike.

programme.title: Tour Auto 2025
programme.desc: The Tour Auto 2025 came to an end after five days of emotion, performance and conviviality on France’s most beautiful roads. From Paris to Nice, this 34th edition brought together over 240 historic vehicles, offering a unique spectacle mixing motor sport, heritage and tradition. Setting off from the Château de Vaux-le-Vicomte in Paris on Tuesday April 8, the participants crossed exceptional landscapes and competed in timed events on circuits and closed roads. Thousands of spectators flocked to each stage, confirming the continuing enthusiasm for the event and its automotive heritage. From Paris to Nice, via Alsace and the Massif Central, each circuit and stopover town gave the competitors a warm welcome.

programme.title: Roaring To Victory - Jaguar
programme.desc: After an absence of almost three decades, Jaguar returned to top flight sportscar racing in 1985. This is the action-packed story of how the legendary British marque roared back to victory. Archive race footage traces the full story of how Tom Walkinshaw Racing took Jaguar to the top, claiming World Championship success and securing Jaguar's first victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours for 31 years. This film features highlights from the road to victory, from the debut of the XJR-6 at Canada's Mosport in August 1985 through to the 1988 Le Mans triumph of the XJR-9LM. You'll see the Tony Southgate-designed Jaguars in action at iconic circuits like Spa, Silverstone, Monza, Fuji and, of course, the Circuit de la Sarthe, from 1985, '86, '87 and '88. There's fabulous race highlights, including in-car footage, featuring Jaguar racing greats including Derek Warwick, Eddie Cheever, Martin Brundle, Jan Lammers, Raul Boesel, John Watson, Johnny Dumfries, Andy Wallace, Jean-Louis Schlesser and more. There's interviews with many of these stars, plus contributions from Tom Walkinshaw and Jaguar chairman Sir John Egan. Roaring to Victory is the comprehensive story of three incredible years.

programme.title: Why the 'second' Niki Lauda was even better than the first
programme.desc: As the Formula 1 paddock sets up in Monaco, the late Niki Lauda is not far from anyone's thoughts following his death earlier this week. Inside the paddock, Edd Straw is joined by Giorgio Piola, who knew Lauda throughout his F1 career, to get a very personal account of what it was like to know the three-time world champion. Piola explains what made Lauda tick, and how his accident in 1976 changed him into a new person who was "even more wonderful than the first".

programme.title: The Top 10 Red Bull F1 Drivers - Part 1
programme.desc: Red Bull is much younger than Formula 1’s other big teams, having arrived in 2005. But in less than two decades it has racked up some impressive achievements. For this list of top 10 F1 drivers, we’ve taken into account the amount of success the racers scored with Red Bull and its sister team Toro Rosso/AlphaTauri, the impact they had and the circumstances of their time within the Red Bull fold. programme.title: The banned Lotus that wasn't actually very good

programme.desc: 1977 World Champ Shaun Tomson explains the source of his resilience.

programme.title: The More Things Change
programme.desc: In the early 70s, Hawaiian surfer Gerry Lopez pioneered the waves at Bali's legendary Uluwatu surf break. Four decades later, Lopez returns to see how much has changed.

programme.title: Surprise Excitement Party
programme.desc: Transworld Surf presents Surprise Excitement Party. Starring Mark Healey, John Florence, Conner Coffin, Parker Coffin, Michel Bourez and many more.

programme.title: Back to the Front
programme.desc: See professional surfers like Ben Bourgeois, Asher Nolan, The Hobgoods, Dean Morrison, Aaron Cormican, Gabe Kling, Jesse Hines, Matt Gilligan, and many more surfing in Australia, Hawaii, Indonesia, Costa Rica, South Africa, East Coast and California in truly epic conditions.

programme.title: Morning of the Earth
programme.desc: The film portrays surfers living in spiritual harmony with nature, making their own boards (and homes) as they traveled in search of the perfect wave across Australia's north-east coast, Bali and Hawaii.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise where Pro surfers have created careers and become legends.

programme.title: The Arena: North Shore
programme.desc: Every winter on the North Shore, the best surfers in the world charge Bonzai Pipeline to prove themselves.

programme.title: Bustin' Down The Door
programme.desc: This documentary explores how a group of surfers revolutionized surfing in 1975.

programme.title: The Essence of Surfing
programme.desc: The Essence of Surfing is a riveting surf documentary that gets to the heart of why surfing is the greatest sport in the world. The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives.

programme.title: And Two If By Sea
programme.desc: The story of iconic professional surfers and identical twins CJ & Damien Hobgood. Their sibling rivalry and struggle to each establish their own identity fueled their careers, but ripped their personal and peripheral relationships apart.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.desc: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

programme.desc: The agents go to Texas where a large number of Federal Gold Bonds are counterfeit.

programme.sub-title: A Night at the Hooterville Hilton
programme.desc: A brochure for the Shady Rest Hotel of the future is prematurely distributed.

programme.desc: Growing up in Southern California, there’s a special spot my dad would always take us: the Eastern Sierras. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

As Ringo tries to stop the counterfeiters, he learns the sheriff, his own partner, is behind it all, complicating the mission.

The three friends stand by him to hearten him and give him advice on coping with the separation and getting back to living a normal life, but surprises are just around the corner.

programme.title: CBS Sports Golazo Matchday
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

After an experiment gone wrong, A.X.L. is discovered hiding alone in the desert by a kind-hearted outsider named Miles (Alex Neustaedter), who finds a way to connect with him after activating his owner-pairing technology. programme.desc: Sam, Lucy, and Erwan head to the naturally beautiful Kabyle region along with locals Dihya Nasri and Walid Assef. programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ex-agent Tae-shik must confront his past when a gang kidnaps a girl he cares for, forcing him into a dangerous mission.

programme.title: The Roundup [English Dub]
programme.desc: Four years after the sweeping operation of Garibong-dong, Detective Ma Seok-do and his unit have an extradition mission - to transfer a surrendered suspect from Vietnam. When Ma and Team Leader Jeon meet him, he seems fearful of something. Ma and Jeon find out that he gets involved in a kidnap/murder case: the victim is a young businessman whose father is the giant loan shark in Seoul. The leader of the crime, Kang Hae-sang, is responsible for several other kidnap/murder cases targeting Koreans in Vietnam. Ma and his colleagues start to chase after Kang before he commits more horrible crimes.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: CHASING THE DRAGON [English Dub]
programme.desc: An illegal immigrant from Mainland China sneaks into the corrupt British-colonized Hong Kong in 1963, transforming himself into a ruthless drug lord.

programme.title: My Way [English Dub]
programme.desc: Rivals Jun Shik and Tatsuo face captivity, separation, and reconciliation amidst colonization and war.

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]
programme.desc: A period drama film, depicting Joseon Dynasty in Korea. Kyoung-su is a skilled acupuncturist but a blind who can only see a little at dark. Right after Kyoung-su joins King Injo’s medical team, the prince comes back after 7 years of living in Chung dynasty. Due to a long journey coming back, the prince becomes ill, and the king’s doctor brings Kyoung-su to heal him. But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: RAGING FIRE [English Dub]
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success in dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when a former protégé resurfaces, seeking revenge.

programme.title: Dirty Money [English Dub]
programme.desc: Two detectives in need; Myung-deuk looks after gang and takes bribes for his sick daughter; Dong-hyeok helps Myung-deuk to settle his gambling debts. One day they hear an information that Chinese gang is shipping a big amount of cash abroad and decide to steal it for themselves. But things go wrong and they're now chased both by police and Chinese gang.

programme.title: Hard Hit [English Dub]
programme.desc: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

programme.title: Hot Blooded [English Dub]
programme.desc: A man born and raised in the outskirts of Busan gets involved in a gangster war for survival. There is no more room to retreat and no where to hide. Whoever hesitates will lose!

programme.title: Brave Citizen [English Dub]

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: “12hrs. & Running”: Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: A cross-country race to lay claim to some of the world’s most sought after works specials.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: Chicago’s Uptown neighborhood is a vibrant, bustling enclave that’s been shaped by distinct layers of history and culture. A longtime refuge for immigrants and LGBTQ+ communities, Uptown is one of the city’s most diverse areas. Dive into this unique neighborhood and come experience Uptown’s cultural richness for yourself.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Virginia is the birthplace of wine in America! We talk with the innovators and pioneers who have helped establish this wine region as one of the most exciting in the county. We also visit a goat cheese farm, one of JFKs favorite hangout towns, Middleburg, and discuss Thomas Jefferson's effect on the region. From juicy Cabernet Franc to floral Viognier, funky Petit Manseng, and powerful Petit Verdot, Virginia has a wine for everyone.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 21: Humillacion y Despidos en la Clinica
programme.desc: Alfonso se asombra cuando se cruza con Marisela en la clínica donde ha ido a examinarse el brazo y se la encuentra convertida en la mejor terapista de la clínica pero no pierde tiempo en tratar de humillarla cuando ella lo reconoce como el Malafé que siempre ha sido. Gabriel está furioso con su secretaria porque encima que no sabe siquiera cual es su nombre todavía no ha encontrado la fotografía que la mandó a buscar y fastidiado termina por despedirla y la mujer se marcha de la oficina llorando. Marisela se enfurece con Alfonso, pero decide dejarlo por imposible y se marcha a la oficina de la psicólogo con quien tiene una cita mientras que Reinaldo es requerido en emergencia y Alfonso se queda solo y mirando con asco a Napoleón a quien le prohíbe tocarlo siquiera

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 64: Betzaida se casa, Romulo huye, Eglee destrozada.
programme.desc: Eglee razona lo que le dijo Marco Aurelio, sobre que ella en el fondo todavía se siente la esposa de Rómulo, no, que va no lo cree, eso que ha engordado tres kilos, en cuanto se los quite también se podrá quitar el anillo y lo botará igual que como lo hizo su ex. Mientras Rómulo que aún no sale del asombro, se encuentra con sus futuros suegros, le parece que es muy pronto como para estar brindando, pero Betzaida insiste. Dileidi no esta segura de ir para la universidad, no quiere encontrarse con su novio aún, Yenilu la convence de que lo haga, total por perder un novio no ha perdido la vida, además donde están las aspiraciones de ella de graduarse y su mamá, donde queda Gladis, todas esas cosas la hacen reflexionar y va a la universidad. Todo lo contrario hace Santiago con Luis Fernando, que en vez de alentar a su amigo para que vaya a dar clases a la universidad, le dice que se quede trabajando, solo que éste no le hace mucho caso y decide ir, la que se queda loca es Tatiana, pues ya estaba segura que ella y Luis Fernando iban a tener una reconciliación segura. Los dos van pensando uno en el otro, ya están en la universidad, se topan en uno de los pasillos, ella quiere hablar pero el la trata con la indiferencia del hielo, le vuelve a recordar que ella lo dejo por otro y que por lo tanto a el no tiene que explicarle nada, de nuevo queda Dileidi confundida, de donde saca el que ella lo dejo por otro, y se queda brava viendo como su novio le va a dar un paseo a Felicita por toda la universidad. Luego una vez en clase, María Gracia no pierde tiempo para coquetear con Luis Fernando, el le disculpa toda su falta de interés por los estudios total con ese físico quien necesita titulo universitario, la que esta que se muere es Dileidi, viendo como su novio o mejor dicho su ex novio coquetea de frente con la otra López, después se pone Luis Fernando a hablar en el salón a decir cualquier cantidad de cosas, que Dileidi sabe que son indirectas que el le esta lanzando, dispuesta a no escuchar mas se retira, y lo deja a el hablando con el grupo. Las que casi se matan son Pascuita y Matilde, quienes no pierden tiempo para decirse cosas pesadas, los maridos de ellas presencian la situación tan incomoda, que gracias al café que trae Gladis no llega a mayores, lo peor es que después cada uno de los maridos cree que el pleito se suscito por ellos, pero no lo comentan entre si. Betzaida esta apurada que quiere que todo el mundo en la oficina se entere de su pronto casamiento con Rómulo, sin embargo el no quiere ir tan rápido. Por otro lado esta mas que segura que si ella quisiera Rómulo vuelve con ella si le diera la gana, piensa que Betzaida es para Rómulo un mientras tanto, no cree que la cosa vaya en serio, total la única señora de el siempre será ella, Marco Aurelio trata de persuadirla, pero que va ella después de esa escena de celos que el le hizo la noche anterior en su casa, esta segurísima. En ese mismo instante Betzaida suelta la bomba invita a sus compañeros a celebrar, todos se quedan locos con la noticia, cuando Eglee sale y ve que no hay nadie trabajando y escucha que hay que celebrar, pregunta y Betzaida aprovecha y se la suelta, ella se casará con Rómulo, ella será la nueva señora García, Eglee no reacciona, el golpe fue duro, enfrenta a Rómulo, no entiende nada, el se va huyendo, Betzaida le pide que se quede, Eglee le grita cobarde, esta demasiado dolida con la noticia, pues hasta hace unos minutos ella juraba ser la única mujer importante en la vida de Rómulo. Theo al fin consigue después de tanto jalar mecate un trabajo en una estación de gasolina, como limpiador de vidrios, a la misma estación llega la Nena, quien como siempre esta peleando por que le llenaron el tanque y ella solo tiene dinero para pagar medio tanque de gasolina, Theo le quiere limpiar el vidrio y ella se molesta pero cuando se da cuenta que es Theo, se molesta aún mas, lo vuelve a insultar pero esta vez como que se le paso la mano, lo humilla de tal manera que el pobre Theo se siente mal por todo lo que le dijo ella, al final de cuentas tiene que reconocer que ella tiene razón, es un hombre que nunca le ha puesto interés a nada en la vida, ni siquiera tiene un empleo digno, una especialización de algo, nada, al final termina reconociendo que es verdad que solo es una ñinguita como lo califico ella. La Nena por su parte esta desesperada por divorciarse pero lo que no sabes es que su amiga Rosa, esta tardando los trámites según lo acordado con Theo. Dileidi le cuenta a sus amigas lo mal que le fue en la universidad, les dice que Luis Fernando le dio con todo, y que al final se fue con las catiritas, ellas la animan a que salgan a rumbear pues ellas no serán sifrinas ni catiras pero en eso de rumbear no les gana nadie. Eglee llega a su casa totalmente desconsolada, le duele hasta el alma, aún no entiende que pasa, el otro que tampoco sabe que pasa el Rómulo quien esta sentado allí en su antigua casa, frente a la mujer que quiere, no sabe como Betzaida le tomo la delantera y lo embauco en ese matrimonio, no sabe que decirle a Eglee cuando esta le pide que por favor le de una explicación de todo eso que les esta pasando.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 9: Disculpas, Reclamos y Planes de Noviazgo
programme.desc: Inés habla con Robert para solicitarle trabajo y se distrae cuando ve a Luis Guillermo hablando con Daniela y Robert le pide que se tranquilice y deje hablar a los enamorados a solas. Y Daniela trata de disculparse con Luis Guillermo que está muy molesto y le reclama por haberlo dejado embarcado al pie del altar Bertha trata de saber que ha pasado entre Michelle y Diego Andrés pero ella la deja con la palabra en la boca y se marcha a su cuarto. Y Marisela está molesta por la forma en que la trató Michelle y jura no volver al cuarto de Diego Andrés Y Michelle se niega a hablar con Flavia sobre lo que hará y ella le pide tiempo para tratar de convencer a su padre y que acepte su noviazgo con Diego Andrés, mientras éste acude al cuarto de Marisela para tratar de disculparse con ella.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: La viuda negra tiene atada a Claudia en una silla, le tapa la cara con un velo y le saca fotos…Luego, se las envía a la dirección de mail de la U.D.H, en la computadora de Sandra…Y todos miran las fotos; pero Tirso se da cuenta por las sillas, que es su casa, y Claudia es la víctima. Tirso, Rogelio, Alejandro y África, van para allá; pero Claudia está muy asustada y les dice que no va a decir nada, para que la viuda negra no la mate. Federico y Vicenta, tiene todo preparado para casarse, y el Juez, los felicita, por haber tomado esa decisión, y más que nada, por proponerse armar una familia; pero Ivana interrumpe la ceremonia.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 21: Furia, embarazo y la nota de amor
programme.desc: Socorro le reclama a Salvador sobre la relación que tiene con su tía Mercedes. Salvador todavía no puede creer que la nota de amor y el dinero lo haya dejado ella. Socorro le dice con furia que estuvo con Fernando y que fue lo mejor que le ha pasado en la vida. Salvador se sorprende. Isabel le cuenta a Manuel que tiene un atraso y después de hacerse la prueba de embarazo, se da cuenta de que está esperando un hijo de Julio Cesar.

En ese mismo instante Betzaida suelta la bomba invita a sus compañeros a celebrar, todos se quedan locos con la noticia, cuando Eglee sale y ve que no hay nadie trabajando y escucha que hay que celebrar, pregunta y Betzaida aprovecha y se la suelta, ella se casará con Rómulo, ella será la nueva señora García, Eglee no reacciona, el golpe fue duro, enfrenta a Rómulo, no entiende nada, el se va huyendo, Betzaida le pide que se quede, Eglee le grita cobarde, esta demasiado dolida con la noticia, pues hasta hace unos minutos ella juraba ser la única mujer importante en la vida de Rómulo. Theo al fin consigue después de tanto jalar mecate un trabajo en una estación de gasolina, como limpiador de vidrios, a la misma estación llega la Nena, quien como siempre esta peleando por que le llenaron el tanque y ella solo tiene dinero para pagar medio tanque de gasolina, Theo le quiere limpiar el vidrio y ella se molesta pero cuando se da cuenta que es Theo, se molesta aún mas, lo vuelve a insultar pero esta vez como que se le paso la mano, lo humilla de tal manera que el pobre Theo se siente mal por todo lo que le dijo ella, al final de cuentas tiene que reconocer que ella tiene razón, es un hombre que nunca le ha puesto interés a nada en la vida, ni siquiera tiene un empleo digno, una especialización de algo, nada, al final termina reconociendo que es verdad que solo es una ñinguita como lo califico ella. La Nena por su parte esta desesperada por divorciarse pero lo que no sabes es que su amiga Rosa, esta tardando los trámites según lo acordado con Theo. Dileidi le cuenta a sus amigas lo mal que le fue en la universidad, les dice que Luis Fernando le dio con todo, y que al final se fue con las catiritas, ellas la animan a que salgan a rumbear pues ellas no serán sifrinas ni catiras pero en eso de rumbear no les gana nadie. Eglee llega a su casa totalmente desconsolada, le duele hasta el alma, aún no entiende que pasa, el otro que tampoco sabe que pasa el Rómulo quien esta sentado allí en su antigua casa, frente a la mujer que quiere, no sabe como Betzaida le tomo la delantera y lo embauco en ese matrimonio, no sabe que decirle a Eglee cuando esta le pide que por favor le de una explicación de todo eso que les esta pasando.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 9: Disculpas, Reclamos y Planes de Noviazgo
programme.desc: Inés habla con Robert para solicitarle trabajo y se distrae cuando ve a Luis Guillermo hablando con Daniela y Robert le pide que se tranquilice y deje hablar a los enamorados a solas. Y Marisela está molesta por la forma en que la trató Michelle y jura no volver al cuarto de Diego Andrés Y Michelle se niega a hablar con Flavia sobre lo que hará y ella le pide tiempo para tratar de convencer a su padre y que acepte su noviazgo con Diego Andrés, mientras éste acude al cuarto de Marisela para tratar de disculparse con ella.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: La viuda negra tiene atada a Claudia en una silla, le tapa la cara con un velo y le saca fotos…Luego, se las envía a la dirección de mail de la U.D.H, en la computadora de Sandra…Y todos miran las fotos; pero Tirso se da cuenta por las sillas, que es su casa, y Claudia es la víctima. Tirso, Rogelio, Alejandro y África, van para allá; pero Claudia está muy asustada y les dice que no va a decir nada, para que la viuda negra no la mate. Federico y Vicenta, tiene todo preparado para casarse, y el Juez, los felicita, por haber tomado esa decisión, y más que nada, por proponerse armar una familia; pero Ivana interrumpe la ceremonia.
